blockers: Same-minute TP and SL hits produce two fills and a position reversal because native Broker has no atomic OCO/cancel-on-fill support.
A bracket submitted after the entry fill cannot protect the entry minute. The entry-open gap and within-minute path can cross either or both fixed levels before protection activates.

A boundary-time signal callback submits after NEXT_BAR open processing and fills at the following minute, not the same boundary open. The signal must be released by the prior minute callback after that minute is complete.
